meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: Claude 会把你的内容做成一个可翻页的演示文稿:有独立幻灯片、逐条展示、分支跳转、热点点击,还带演讲者备注;也能把现有网页转成幻灯片。产出的是可交互的页面,不是视频。
howto.when: 当你说“slideshow”或明确要求做幻灯片时直接触发;若说“presentation”“pitch deck”等相近词,会先确认再制作。

say.text: 帮我把这份大纲做成一个幻灯片,带演讲者备注。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个可翻页的演示页面。

say.text: 把这个网页转成可交互的幻灯片,保留原有动画。
say.note: 按源页面转换,需确认后开始。

say.text: 在幻灯片里加一个热点分支,指向补充数据页。
say.note: 会在对应幻灯片创建可点击热点。

howto.what_en: Turns your content into a navigable deck: slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, presenter mode with speaker notes; can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is an interactive page, not a video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'slideshow' or explicitly ask for a slide deck; for adjacent requests like 'presentation' or 'pitch deck', it will confirm before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a slideshow with speaker notes.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a navigable deck.

say_en.text: Convert this webpage into an interactive deck, keeping its animations.
Add a hotspot branch in the slide pointing to a detail page.
say_en.note: Creates a clickable hotspot on that slide.
